freeze_record.timing: before any local-affordance comparative development result
freeze_record.reason: test whether current-state-local transition effects add information beyond the pooled S representation after the outcome-group diagnostic found pooled outcome channels harmful

raw_probe_evidence_authority.purpose: new immutable raw-probe evidence because prior Phase 3 artifacts retain pooled affordance tables but not raw probe rows

task_raw_artifacts.factorization: 6 development families x 5 replicates x 8 tasks
task_raw_artifacts.identity: exactly one sorted manifest entry per (family_id, replicate, task_id), with no missing, duplicate, or extra identity
task_raw_artifacts.rows: each row is exactly one learner-observable ObservedTransition plus its canonical probe_index
task_raw_artifacts.reducer_population: one task raw artifact only; rows from different task, replicate, family, phase, or artifact identities are never pooled
task_raw_artifacts.probe_index_uniqueness: the zero-based probe_index values 0..63 occur exactly once within each reducer population

training_evidence_manifests.identity: exactly one sorted manifest per (fold_id, replicate), with no missing, duplicate, or extra identity
training_evidence_manifests.reference_source: reuse the exact immutable v1 sanitized optimum traces bound by each canonical Phase 3 evidence digest; do not rerun or alter reference trajectories
training_evidence_manifests.pooled_table_parity: for every task, rebuilding the pooled affordance table from the new raw rows must be byte-identical to the canonical v1 pooled table or the artifact is invalid

heldout_probe_bindings.factorization: 6 folds x 5 replicates x 8 heldout tasks
heldout_probe_bindings.identity: exactly one sorted binding per (fold_id, replicate, task_id), where fold_id equals the heldout family and each binding selects the matching task raw artifact

probe_policy.canonical_probe_index: zero-based action order within the fixed 64-action probe stream
probe_policy.logical_identity_digest: bind each condition view to the exact raw-row bytes and digest for fold, replicate, task, phase, and probe_index

learner_visibility.probe_index_use: artifact verification and deterministic reducer tie-breaking only; never serialize probe_index into a learner feature tensor or training example
learner_visibility.metadata_use: metadata may bind storage and audit identity but must not be serialized into learner inputs or examples

immutability.byte_and_digest_identity: all four conditions consume byte-identical raw rows for each logical identity
immutability.consumer_charge: each condition consumer is charged the full 64 probe actions even when a raw artifact is shared
immutability.fold_view_isolation: model preparation receives capabilities only for the 40 task artifacts named by its (fold_id, replicate) training manifest; it cannot enumerate or read the heldout family's task artifacts or any heldout binding
immutability.heldout_view_isolation: candidate generation receives exactly one authorized heldout task binding for its planned unit; it cannot enumerate or read any other task raw artifact
immutability.readiness_check: fail closed on any missing, extra, duplicate, cross-fold, cross-replicate, or unauthorized task-artifact capability

raw_store_layout.method_selection_effect: clarifies storage and identity validation only; does not change the frozen method-selection rule, eligible hyperparameters, seeds, budgets, or conditions
raw_store_layout.completed_authority_directory_policy: the root and each namespace must contain exactly the declared entries; staging, temporary, backup, hidden, or other extra entries are forbidden
raw_store_layout.canonical_file_format: UTF-8 JSON with one trailing newline; canonical serialization and exact filenames are required
raw_store_layout.filename_policy: filenames are exact, namespace-local, and traversal-free; symlinks and non-regular files are rejected

canonical_files.artifacts: artifacts/{artifact_id}.json: persisted envelope containing typed key, body, manifest, and affordances; reducer capabilities are never persisted

identity_requirements.namespace_contents: exactly 240 artifacts, 240 keys, 30 training-fold manifests, and 240 heldout bindings; missing, duplicate, extra, symlink, or non-regular entries fail closed
identity_requirements.task_index: task_index is always the actual development manifest index used by the frozen seed formula, never the ordinal 0..7 position within a selected task array
identity_requirements.generator_and_environment: generator_seed and environment_reset_seed must equal the exact values in the selected development manifest entry

cost_ownership.physical_formula: 240 unique task raw artifacts x 64 actions
cost_ownership.consumer_formula: 11520 comparative units x 64 paid probe actions
cost_ownership.reporting_rule: report physical preparation actions and consumer-equivalent restricted interactions separately; never sum them as though both were distinct environment interactions and never describe shared probes as free
cost_ownership.prior_v1_reuse_exception: the earlier Phase 3 zero-charge evidence-reuse statement does not apply to this new raw-row capture; the 15360 physical actions are a new reported preparation cost

development_matrix.unit_formula: 4 conditions x 12 tuples x 6 heldout families x 5 replicates x 8 tasks

conditions.representation: global optimum-imitation representation on the new raw evidence
conditions.capacity_policy: retain full grid, examples, labels, optimizer, updates, probes, candidate episodes, search and adaptation budgets; never restrict B2

conditions.representation: five current-state scalars plus the exact S-masked pooled 49-vector: outcome indices 4..10 are zero in every summary block
conditions.bitwise_parity_requirement: S candidate tensors must equal the canonical S mask built from the same captured rows

conditions.representation: exact S representation, with outcome indices 4..10 filled from all same-alias rows rather than a current-state-local subset
conditions.control: preserve every raw row and action count while removing learner-visible local pre-state/effect alignment
conditions.bitwise_parity_requirement: P candidate tensors must equal the canonical full T transform built from the same captured rows

conditions.representation: exact S-masked candidate row with only the zeroed outcome indices 4..10 filled by a deterministic current-state-local same-alias summary

capacity_matching.rule: all pairwise trainable-parameter differences must be within the symmetric tolerance; fixed preprocessing adds no learned parameters and B2 retains its full capacity and budget

local_affordance_transform.base: start from the exact S-masked pooled 49-vector for the candidate alias, whose outcome indices 4..10 are zero in every summary block
local_affordance_transform.application: recompute from the shared immutable raw rows at every training and candidate-search decision using that decision's current learner-observable state
local_affordance_transform.distance_definition: squared Euclidean distance over the four canonical bounded pre-state coordinates
local_affordance_transform.row_order: within exactly one task raw artifact, sort same-alias probe rows by distance ascending, breaking ties by the unique canonical probe_index ascending
local_affordance_transform.k_eff: min(4, n) where n is the same-alias row count
local_affordance_transform.unknown_alias: zero/neutral outcome and no local lookup; use the frozen eligible uniform fallback
local_affordance_transform.preprocessing: no radius, learned preprocessing, adaptive k, or additional selectable transform
local_affordance_transform.pooled_control: P fills indices 4..10 from all same-alias rows, preserving every row and count and removing local alignment

shared_training_and_search.examples: same optimum reference-decision identities, selected labels, candidate-alias order, example order, and batch order for B2, S, P, and L; only the declared candidate feature representation differs
shared_training_and_search.oracle_timing: after complete fixed candidate batch and independent replay
shared_training_and_search.condition_pairing: identical model, probe, search, data-order, family, task, fold, replicate and candidate-tuple seed identities

model_owner_identity.temperature_reuse: one model owner serves the three search-temperature consumers for the same condition, fold, replicate, and training tuple without retraining
model_owner_identity.owner_formula: 4 conditions x 6 folds x 5 replicates x 4 (learning_rate, training_epochs) tuples = 480
model_owner_identity.selected_tuple_cost_scope: sum exactly 30 unique model-owner reports for the selected condition and training tuple: 6 folds x 5 replicates; never multiply by heldout tasks or search temperatures

seed_policy.formula: base + family_order_index * 10000 + replicate * 100000 + task_index where a task component applies
seed_policy.condition_pairing: B2, S, P and L use identical non-label seeds for each matched logical unit

steps: independently select one tuple for each of B2, S, P and L over the complete 12-tuple grid
retain tuples within inclusive 0.05 absolute of that condition's best minimum-family success
minimize macro-average family median restricted interactions
minimize summed unique model-owner optimizer steps, then forward passes, then recurrent steps
selection_rule.restricted_interactions: paid heldout probes plus candidate-generation actions through first post-hoc exact candidate; failures use 2049
selection_rule.tie_breaking: inherited exactly from the frozen Phase 3 selector; no changes after results

query_populations.training: every available candidate alias at every optimum reference-decision pre-state in the 30 training evidence manifests
query_populations.heldout: every available candidate alias at every learner-observable pre-state in the 240 fixed heldout 64-action probe bindings
query_populations.forbidden: candidate-search trajectories, exact-optimum classifications, evaluator results, and comparative condition outcomes

diagnostics.reporting: compute after raw-evidence freeze but before model preparation or candidate search; report separately for training and heldout query populations and by family; diagnostics cannot select tuples or alter the protocol

alignment_claim_gate.eligible_row: known alias with n > 4 and at least two distinct outcome vectors
alignment_claim_gate.effective_change: local-vs-pooled outcome-block bytes differ for the eligible row
alignment_claim_gate.failure: if the gate fails, forbid any local-alignment claim without changing the run

claim_and_advancement_rule.conditional_transition_claim: L minimum-family success minus S must be strictly greater than 0.05
claim_and_advancement_rule.local_alignment_claim: L minimum-family success minus P must be strictly greater than 0.05 and the alignment_claim_gate must pass
claim_and_advancement_rule.full_rung_claim: requires both the conditional-transition and local-alignment criteria
claim_and_advancement_rule.within_tolerance: a difference at or below 0.05 supports no robust claim
claim_and_advancement_rule.history_advancement: requires both full-rung criteria, no development-family drop greater than 0.05 versus independently selected B2, and L minimum-family success no more than 0.05 below B2
claim_and_advancement_rule.historical_phase3_results: contextual only; never pool historical results with this rerun

authorization_requires: raw evidence schema and immutable authority implementation
typed sanitizer enforcement proving probe_index and identity metadata cannot enter learner tensors or examples
capability-scoped fold isolation proving model preparation cannot read heldout task artifacts or bindings
readiness with immutable bytes and descriptor identities
